What I'd tell a brand team

  • Early buzz is normal, not a green light. Search interest was already rising before RISE comebacks, including FADED of the ones that faded.
  • Test whether demand holds. A limited run or a few regions shows whether people come back after the first spike.
  • Judge it after launch. Watch what happens once the novelty wears off, not the noise before it.

The first point is exploratory: found after the test, so it is a lead to check, not a result.
